fields.label: iter13: 0x0055c4f0 PhysicsBodySetFriction C2->C3
fields.value: Commit aa1887f5. Recursive body-tree setter. Extended ptr_seed_observe with {buf,off,ptr_to:j} so a seed can build a struct GRAPH — needed because the function double-derefs its arg and a flat seed just AVs. The screening brief's struct_call_observe recommendation was rejected: its 2nd arg is an out-pointer, not a caller scalar, so param_2 would have been constant and the GREEN degenerate. GREEN 5/5 branch-covering: proved the childless-compound path writes nothing AND that the recursion descends to the child.
